openings.claim: Pencil pattern and quantities on each envelope; tick only after insertion. This may reduce memory-dependent omissions and make distribution assignments visible.
openings.discriminator: With matched mixtures and unchanged shared trays, cues should reduce omissions and exchanges. Loose local staging succeeding while cued shared trays fail favors picking interference; correctly ticked incomplete envelopes defeat insertion checking.
openings.probe: Within 18 minutes including preparation and audit, the same two volunteers alternate three four-kit batches: incumbent shared trays, cued shared trays, and local staging without cues. Match mixtures; tally crossings, preparation, assembly, checking and omissions; audit against samples. Stop if staging exceeds the table.
openings.uncertainty: Legibility, staging footprint and probe feasibility are unverified. O4's mixture is unknown; picking versus filling remains unresolved. Small batches cannot qualify the full target.

openings.claim: Make existing samples active references: compare actual quantities and dimensions with the assigned sample before closure, then verify pattern correspondence at distribution.
openings.discriminator: More consultation should expose omissions before closure. Persistent shared-item omissions favor picking interference. Exceeding 90 minutes, more than one correction, or a wrong-pattern handoff defeats full qualification.
openings.probe: Rehearse all 60 assigned kits with two volunteers; time consultation, replenishment, checking and assignment verification together. Stop at 90 minutes; tally completed kits, caught omissions, remaining corrections and wrong-pattern handoffs.
openings.uncertainty: Sample accuracy, representative mixtures, available assignments, full stock, combined footprint and assignment verification through samples remain unconfirmed.

lineage.reason: Preserves quantity cues, insertion checking, exterior assignment and staging rival.
Preserves active sample comparison and full-session qualification.

decision: Retain distinct candidates; effects remain untested synthetic hypotheses. Require 60 complete assigned kits within 90 minutes and at most one distribution correction; preserve specified quantities and dimensions, exactly two volunteers, the 180-by-75-centimetre table, existing envelopes and supplies, and no equipment or purchases. Neither candidate is qualified.
